title: Reconstruction of power house, office, store room and general maintenance of Tolkeshwar Lighthouse station.
summary: E-tender (two-bid, percentage BoQ) for reconstruction of the power house, office and store room attached to the lighthouse tower, special repairs to the tower, a toilet block, security cabin, paver-block road, dwarf wall and general maintenance at Tolkeshwar Point Lighthouse, Guhagar, Ratnagiri, Maharashtra (Mumbai Directorate).

money.performance_security: Performance Guarantee 5% of contract value (FDR/BG) before work order, plus Security Deposit 5% deducted from RA bills, released after 6 months defect liability period
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST (BoQ total Rs 96,86,148.19). EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, payable at Mumbai, valid three months from technical bid opening; MSME/NSIC firms must also submit EMD. Quantities may vary +/-25%. Water and electricity if provided by department recovered at 1% each of tender cost.

period.completion: 09 months from date of award of contract
period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Registered licensed contractors/firms of appropriate category with Central Govt/State Govt/Municipal Corporation having tender limits equal to or more than estimated cost

Similar works (civil construction, repair and maintenance) in last 7 years: three each >= Rs 38.74 lakh (40%), or two each >= Rs 58.12 lakh (60%), or one >= Rs 77.49 lakh (80%); sub-contractor experience not considered
Average annual turnover >= 30% of estimated cost (Rs 29,05,844) in last three financial years (printed as ending 31.03.2024 and 31.03.2025 in different places)
PAN; GST registration; ITRs for 2021-22 to 2023-24
Tender acceptance letter, unconditional bid undertaking, bid securing declaration, notarised non-blacklisting affidavit, declaration of no relatives in MoPSW/DGLL, Make in India self-certification

Technical evaluation minimum 70/100: statutory requirements 30, financial standing 20, similar experience 20, performance of previous works 20, key technical personnel 10 (1 graduate civil engineer, 2 diploma civil engineers)
specs: Works per CPWD specifications (civil and electrical volumes) and BIS codes; 53 grade OPC/PPC from manufacturers with >= 1 MTPA capacity
Paint shades: snow/brilliant white and signal red for trestle/GI/RCC tower; bus green for automation box and hand rail; black for gate and pedestal
